transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer service. My name is Simon. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Simon. I am calling from my mobile about my elderly mother's landline number, 0121 496 0842. She's locked out of her 1571 voicemail service because she forgot her four-digit pass code.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that voicemail access lockout for you, Quinton. May I have the customer account reference number displayed on the paper bill?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the account reference number is SN-902-411.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Quinton. And what is your mother's full name listed on the account registry?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Her name is Eleanor Davies. She is eighty-four years old and relies on this landline for hospital appointment voicemails, so she was in a real state of anxiety when the automated voice kept saying invalid code!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how worrying that is for both you and your mother, Quinton, especially with important hospital messages. Please don't worry, we will reset that mailbox and make sure she can access her messages today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Simon, that is very comforting to hear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have understood correctly, your mother entered an incorrect four-digit code multiple times on 1571, causing the exchange mailbox to enter security lockout, and she cannot retrieve messages from her healthcare providers. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly the problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am opening the telephony exchange switchboard console for the Birmingham area.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, take your time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now, could you tell me again what the landline telephone number is?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of the call, it's 0121 496 0842.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, pulling up 0121 496 0842 on the switchboard now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does it show that the mailbox is locked?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the status flag indicates 'SECURITY LOCKOUT - 3 FAILED ATTEMPTS'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you reset the code to a temporary one that she can easily remember?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously security policy prohibits resetting mailbox credentials without generating an encrypted one-time security token from the server, Quinton.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, how does that one-time token work?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will generate a temporary default passcode of 1234 on the switchboard. Then, when your mother dials 1571 from her landline handset, the system will prompt her to choose her own new four-digit code.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is very straightforward and easy for an elderly person to follow. Can we do that reset right now while I'm here visiting her house in Birmingham?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, absolutely. I am clearing the failed security counter on the exchange switchboard and programming the temporary default passcode 1234 on her line right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I am standing in the hallway right next to her telephone base station. Should I pick up the handset now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, please pick up the handset and dial 1571.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Picking up... dialing 1-5-7-1... the automated voice says 'Welcome to S-Net 1571. Please enter your temporary four-digit code followed by the hash key.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Press 1 2 3 4 followed by hash.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressing 1 2 3 4 hash... it says 'Temporary code accepted. Please enter your new four-digit code.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Help your mother enter her chosen new four-digit code twice to confirm.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: She is typing her birth year... and confirming it... the voice says 'Your new code has been saved successfully'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Brilliant. Now does the system announce any unread voicemails waiting in the inbox?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It says 'You have two new messages'! Message one is from Queen Elizabeth Hospital confirming her cardiology appointment for next Thursday at 10 AM! What a colossal relief, Simon!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is wonderful news, Quinton! I am so glad she was able to hear that vital hospital appointment.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: She has written it down in her diary right now. Message two was from Boots pharmacy confirming her prescription will be delivered tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Both critical medical communications are safely received and documented.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can we also set up a custom voicemail greeting so callers know it's her?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. In the 1571 main menu, press option 3 for Mailbox Settings, then option 2 to Record a Personal Greeting.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressing 3 then 2... she is speaking her greeting into the receiver right now... pressing hash to finish. It played back and sounds very clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We can also adjust the ring duration before 1571 answers, increasing it from four rings to six rings so she has more time to reach the handset.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, that would be wonderful! Sometimes she struggles to get up from her armchair in time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have adjusted the ring delay to thirty seconds on the exchange switchboard, giving her six full rings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is going to be so much easier for her.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also test the 1571 stutter dial tone feature so you know when a message is waiting without dialing in.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How does the stutter dial tone work on the handset?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When an unread message is stored in 1571, the dial tone beeps rapidly when lifting the receiver to alert the subscriber.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me lift the receiver to listen... yes! It has a distinct broken dial tone signaling the new messages.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once she deletes or listens to all messages, the tone automatically returns to a solid continuous pitch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is an excellent visual and audible prompt for her.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: She can also press 3 during playback to delete old messages or press 2 to save them indefinitely.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will show her how pressing three deletes messages she has already noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will remain the dedicated owner for this support ticket, Quinton, and I will keep this case on follow-up monitoring for forty-eight hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Simon, your help today has been truly invaluable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the handset volume settings on the telephone base to ensure ringtones are audible across the house.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Turning the volume slider to High on the side of the base... the test ring is nice and loud now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That will help ensure she never misses incoming calls from family or doctors.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that will make a huge difference for her peace of mind.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can we also check that her priority care registration is active on her customer profile?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, she has a priority care marker for power cuts and line faults due to her age.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I see the Priority Fault Repair flag is active on her telephone circuit record.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives us such great reassurance.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your mother's S-Net landline or broadband service that I can help with today, Quinton?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that has solved everything completely. Thank you again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You may receive a brief automated survey after this call; we would be grateful if you could rate our customer service today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will definitely give you top marks. Thank you, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Quinton. Take care and goodbye.
